When real time actually means real time

takeaways: Declare only the Graph scopes you need in the solution package, get admin approval and always test with a normal user account.
Keep calls fast with select, caching and libraries like PnPjs and the Microsoft Graph Toolkit instead of hand-written fetch boilerplate.
Replace polling with SharePoint webhooks, an Azure broadcaster and Socket.IO over WebSockets so web parts update in near real time.
hook: Your SPFx web part looks polished, but users ignore it because the data is stale. This episode is for SharePoint developers and shows how to wire in live data through Microsoft Graph with the right permissions, make calls fast with select and caching, and push real-time updates with webhooks and WebSockets.
